title: PM Shehbaz, PPP Review Khyber Pakhtunkhwa After Emergency and Governor's Rule
detail: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif convened PML-N and PPP leaders, including PPP chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari, to review the situation in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa after emergency and governor's rule were imposed there on a cabinet decision approved by the president. Governor Faisal Karim Kundi briefed on administrative measures and terrorism, and Balochistan's security situation was also discussed. The meeting pressed for a Parliamentary Committee on Electoral Reforms, with the PPP to submit nominees to the NA Speaker. The PM separately met Field Marshal Asim Munir, Chief of Defence Forces, on the overall situation.

media.caption: Leaders review Khyber Pakhtunkhwa situation after federal takeover
